svg.title: Thirty days to a controlled pilot
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-30-day-roadmap; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty days to a controlled pilot; subtitle: Readiness milestones, not a collection deadline; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are milestone end-days; ranges are calendar targets, not statutory deadlines.; caption: The first month should produce a reviewable process and documented cases, not an unsupported income promise.; stages: label: Choose the lane; value: Days 1-7; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Select one jurisdiction, custodian and claim type; get legal gates reviewed.; label: Build the controls; value: Days 8-14; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Set record provenance, privacy, case budgets and written stop rules.; label: Run a small cohort; value: Days 15-21; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Screen a bounded batch and build evidence only for qualified leads.; label: Review and decide; value: Days 22-30; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Audit economics and compliance; continue, redesign or stop the pilot.

text.tspan: Thirty days to a controlled pilot

circle.title: label: Choose the lane; value: Days 1-7; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Select one jurisdiction, custodian and claim type; get legal gates reviewed.
label: Build the controls; value: Days 8-14; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Set record provenance, privacy, case budgets and written stop rules.
label: Run a small cohort; value: Days 15-21; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Screen a bounded batch and build evidence only for qualified leads.
label: Review and decide; value: Days 22-30; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Audit economics and compliance; continue, redesign or stop the pilot.
